text: Isaiah is 12, autistic and nonverbal, he talks with his iPad (TouchChat). Please never take the iPad away, it's his voice. He has pica, so he puts crayons, play-doh and small toys in his mouth and swallows them. Keep small stuff out of reach. He runs toward the parking lot if a door is open, he doesn't understand cars. His mom and I are divorced but both of us can pick him up, there is NO restriction (the old form from 2024 was wrong). He likes trains, Thomas especially.
